title: For the 58th Time: Maccabi Tel Aviv Are Champions of Israel
description: Maccabi Tel Aviv are champions of Israel for the 58th time in their history. Oded Katash's side beat Hapoel Tel Aviv 83-79 on Tuesday night in a thrilling Game 4 of the Winner League playoff final, completing a 3-1 series win to lift the championship plate once again. Having earlier won the State Cup, the Yellows sealed their first domestic double since 2020/21, capping a challenging campaign in the sweetest fashion.
imageCaption: For the 58th Time: Maccabi Tel Aviv Are Champions of Israel (Photo: Maccabi)

title: Maccabi Tel-Aviv defend Winner League title
description: M.Tel-Aviv - H.Tel-Aviv 82-74 Maccabi Tel-Aviv repeated as Winner League champions. They overcame Hapoel Tel-Aviv in the decisive third game of the Finals to defend the title. Hapoel Tel-Aviv was trailing by 1 point at halftime but managed to get 1-point lead after three quarters before a 28-19 charge of Maccabi Tel-Aviv, which allowed them to win the game. M.Tel-Aviv outrebounded H.Tel-Aviv 46-25 including a 27-16 advantage in defensive rebounds. M.Tel-Aviv looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a great evening for the former international power forward Roman Sorkin (210-1996, college: Oregon) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 9 rebounds. Cuban power forward Jasiel Rivero (206-1993, agency: Pro Sports) helped adding 16 points and 8 rebounds (on 7-of-8 shooting from the field). Maccabi Tel-Aviv's coach Oded Kattash used a ten-player rotation…
imageCaption: Maccabi Tel-Aviv defend Winner League title (Photo: basket.co.il)

title: Maccabi Tel Aviv are 22/23 Winner League champions
description: M.Tel-Aviv - H.Tel-Aviv 94-90 Maccabi Tel Aviv claimed Winner League title. They held off Hapoel Tel Aviv in the decisive third game of the championship series to secure the trophy. Hapoel Tel-Aviv trailed by 11 points after 3 quarters before a 26-19 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 90-94 at the end of the game. Maccabi Tel-Aviv made 27-of-34 free shots (79.4 percent) during the game. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when Maccabi Tel-Aviv made 7 blocks. 29 personal fouls committed by Hapoel Tel-Aviv helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a good game for American point guard Wade Baldwin IV (193-1996, college: Vanderbilt) who led his team to a victory with 22 points, 6 rebounds and 8 assists. American-Spanish point guard Lorenzo Brown (196-1990, college: NC State) contributed with 22 points and 7 assists for the winners.…
imageCaption: Maccabi Tel Aviv are 22/23 Winner League champions (Photo: basket.co.il)

title: Hapoel Holon are Winner League champions
description: H.Holon - Bnei Hertzeliya 90-74 Hapoel Holon conquered Winner Basket League title. They knocked down Bnei Hertzeliya to sweep the championship series. The victory marked the second Winner League trophy in the team's history. Hapoel Holon led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. American-Liberian point guard Joe Ragland (182-1989, college: Wichita St.) orchestrated the victory by scoring 23 points and 7 assists. American Tyrus McGee (188-1991, college: Iowa St., agency: Alti Sport) contributed with 16 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Five Hapoel Holon players scored in double figures. American Maurice Kemp (203-1991, college: ECU) replied with 21 points and 5 rebounds (was perfect 11-for-11 from the free throw line !!!) and his fellow American import power forward Chinanu Onuaku (207-1996, college: Louisville, agency: MSG) added…
imageCaption: Hapoel Holon are Winner League champions (Photo: gazzetta.gr)

title: Maccabi Tel Aviv defend Winner League title
description: Maccabi T-A - H.Galil Gilboa 73-67 Maccabi Tel Aviv clinched Israeli League title. They overcame Galil Gilboa in the decisive third game of the Finals to conquer the fourth straight Winner League trophy. Galil Gilboa trailed by 13 points at halftime and as many as 14 after three quarters before a 20-12 last quarter charge cut the deficit to 67-73 at the end of the game. 24 personal fouls committed by Galil Gilboa helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was American-Turkish guard Scottie Wilbekin (188-93, college: Florida, agency: BeoBasket) who scored 19 points. The former international swingman Yovel Zoosman (200-98) chipped in 8 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists.
